sources.effective_version: October 12 supplemental review: Read the full official Lexis text of 18-44-101, 107, 114, 115 and 117, current through the First Extraordinary Session 2026 including Code Revision Commission revisions. The earlier CAPTCHA limitation is superseded for these sections. Retain the first-delivery notice choice, direct-sale classification, bond exclusions, service proof and no-forward-extension limits. The 75th-day wording and owner-direct classification remain explicit legal-owner decisions. The effective_from date remains a bounded implementation proposal, not an original enactment date. October 13 implementation correction: the dated note supplement supersedes contrary calendar-confirmation, mandatory optional-payment-term and result-status choices; original source-read currency remains as recorded. Series 02: October 13 session-index and Act 479 checks strengthen the retained October 12 full-text receipt; the fresh publisher retry reached CAPTCHA and is not a new full-text read.

Source as reported in the bound Peter form, read 2026-10-11. Full current sections not read; current snippets and Acts; full browser read required before release. The effective_from date is a bounded implementation proposal, not an asserted original enactment date. Series 02: October 13 session-index and Act 479 checks strengthen the retained October 12 full-text receipt; the fresh publisher retry reached CAPTCHA and is not a new full-text read.

warnings: Draft implementation of the bound #327 form; exact implementation approval and canonical promotion are required before release.
The form preserves its original source-access and amendment-review limits. No new current-law review is claimed by this implementation.
Additional service, recording and amount conditions described below remain mandatory; this calculator is not a notice-sending or lien-filing service.
No weekend shift is applied. File earlier if the clerk is closed and move the ten-day owner notice earlier by the same amount; actual service must precede filing by ten days.
Residential receipt must precede actual project commencement; first-delivery minus one is only the supplier target. Late notice protects only later supply and requires review.
Full current §§18-44-114/115 and unresolved intervening amendments must be read before release; snippets and enacted Acts do not close this gate.

preliminary_notice.name: 75-day commercial notice and ten-day owner notice
preliminary_notice.description: Serve owner AND contractor first+75, including owner-hired suppliers under the safe-side decision. Separately give owner ten days before actual filing; calculate the ten-day target from the advised earlier filing date, keeping statutory filing expiration at last+120. File by 2026-08-14 to avoid a closed filing day; the date calculated under this policy remains 2026-08-15.

notice_duties.name: Commercial owner and contractor notice
notice_duties.description: Serve the owner and contractor within 75 days after first furnishing under the retained safe-side policy, including owner-hired suppliers. This first-delivery duty is separate from the ten-day pre-filing owner notice.

planned_notice_targets.name: Ten-day owner notice planning target
planned_notice_targets.description: This target assumes filing on the stated earlier filing date. Give the owner the full ten-day notice interval before actual filing; earlier actual filing requires an earlier notice. This planning target is not a universal statutory expiration and does not establish service or receipt.

lien_filing.name: File account and affidavit with circuit clerk
lien_filing.description: File account and affidavit with circuit clerk under the bound form; required service and filing conditions still apply. File by 2026-12-11 to avoid a closed filing day; the date calculated under this policy remains 2026-12-12.

File by 2026-08-14 to avoid a closed filing day; the date calculated under this policy remains 2026-08-16.

notice_duties.name: Commercial owner and contractor notice
notice_duties.description: Serve the owner and contractor within 75 days after first furnishing under the retained safe-side policy, including owner-hired suppliers. This first-delivery duty is separate from the ten-day pre-filing owner notice.

planned_notice_targets.name: Ten-day owner notice planning target
planned_notice_targets.description: This target assumes filing on the stated earlier filing date. Give the owner the full ten-day notice interval before actual filing; earlier actual filing requires an earlier notice. This planning target is not a universal statutory expiration and does not establish service or receipt.

lien_filing.name: File account and affidavit with circuit clerk
lien_filing.description: File account and affidavit with circuit clerk under the bound form; required service and filing conditions still apply.

preliminary_notice.name: Prime notice and intent notice
preliminary_notice.description: Serve prime notice within ten days and intent at least thirty days before actual filing; both apply. Calculate the filing action target first, then subtract the full pre-filing notice interval; any notice-day adjustment moves earlier.

notice_duties.name: Ten-day prime notice
notice_duties.description: With own subcontractors or suppliers and no written owner contract, serve the separate prime notice on the owner or authorized agent within ten days after first furnishing. The later notice of intent is separate.

planned_notice_targets.name: Thirty-day owner intent planning target
planned_notice_targets.description: This target assumes filing on the stated earlier filing date. Serve the owner notice of intent at least thirty days before actual filing; earlier actual filing requires an earlier notice. This planning target is not a universal statutory expiration and does not establish service or receipt.

lien_filing.name: File claim with circuit court clerk
lien_filing.description: Six calendar months, clamping missing month-day as the approved earlier target. Filing must wait thirty days after actual intent service.

preliminary_notice.name: Prime notice and intent notice
preliminary_notice.description: Serve prime notice within ten days and intent at least thirty days before actual filing; both apply. Calculate the filing action target first, then subtract the full pre-filing notice interval; any notice-day adjustment moves earlier.

notice_duties.name: Ten-day prime notice
notice_duties.description: With own subcontractors or suppliers and no written owner contract, serve the separate prime notice on the owner or authorized agent within ten days after first furnishing. The later notice of intent is separate.

planned_notice_targets.name: Thirty-day owner intent planning target
planned_notice_targets.description: This target assumes filing on the stated earlier filing date. Serve the owner notice of intent at least thirty days before actual filing; earlier actual filing requires an earlier notice. This planning target is not a universal statutory expiration and does not establish service or receipt.

lien_filing.name: File claim with circuit court clerk
lien_filing.description: Six calendar months, clamping missing month-day as the approved earlier target. Filing must wait thirty days after actual intent service.

preliminary_notice.name: 60-day supplier notice and 30-day intent
preliminary_notice.description: Serve two signed copies of supplier notice on owner/agent; separately serve intent at least thirty days before actual filing. Calculate the filing action target first, then subtract the full pre-filing notice interval; any notice-day adjustment moves earlier.

notice_duties.name: Sixty-day supplier notice
notice_duties.description: Serve the statutory supplier notice in two signed copies on the owner or authorized agent within sixty days after first furnishing. The later notice of intent is separate; this date does not establish service or receipt.

planned_notice_targets.name: Thirty-day owner intent planning target
planned_notice_targets.description: This target assumes filing on the stated earlier filing date. Serve the owner notice of intent at least thirty days before actual filing; earlier actual filing requires an earlier notice. This planning target is not a universal statutory expiration and does not establish service or receipt.

lien_filing.name: File claim with circuit court clerk
lien_filing.description: Six calendar months, clamping missing month-day as the approved earlier target. Filing must wait thirty days after actual intent service.

preliminary_notice.name: 60-day supplier notice and 30-day intent

notice_duties.name: Sixty-day supplier notice
notice_duties.description: Serve the statutory supplier notice in two signed copies on the owner or authorized agent within sixty days after first furnishing. The later notice of intent is separate; this date does not establish service or receipt.

planned_notice_targets.name: Thirty-day owner intent planning target
planned_notice_targets.description: This target assumes filing on the stated earlier filing date. Serve the owner notice of intent at least thirty days before actual filing; earlier actual filing requires an earlier notice. This planning target is not a universal statutory expiration and does not establish service or receipt.

lien_filing.name: File claim with circuit court clerk
lien_filing.description: Six calendar months, clamping missing month-day as the approved earlier target. Filing must wait thirty days after actual intent service.

preliminary_notice.name: 60-day supplier notice and 30-day intent
preliminary_notice.description: Serve two signed copies of supplier notice on owner/agent; separately serve intent at least thirty days before actual filing. Calculate the filing action target first, then subtract the full pre-filing notice interval; any notice-day adjustment moves earlier.

notice_duties.name: Sixty-day supplier notice
notice_duties.description: Serve the statutory supplier notice in two signed copies on the owner or authorized agent within sixty days after first furnishing. The later notice of intent is separate; this date does not establish service or receipt.

planned_notice_targets.name: Thirty-day owner intent planning target
planned_notice_targets.description: This target assumes filing on the stated earlier filing date. Serve the owner notice of intent at least thirty days before actual filing; earlier actual filing requires an earlier notice. This planning target is not a universal statutory expiration and does not establish service or receipt.

lien_filing.name: File claim with circuit court clerk
lien_filing.description: Six calendar months, clamping missing month-day as the approved earlier target. Filing must wait thirty days after actual intent service.

preliminary_notice.name: 60-day supplier notice and 30-day intent

notice_duties.name: Sixty-day supplier notice
notice_duties.description: Serve the statutory supplier notice in two signed copies on the owner or authorized agent within sixty days after first furnishing. The later notice of intent is separate; this date does not establish service or receipt.

planned_notice_targets.name: Thirty-day owner intent planning target
planned_notice_targets.description: This target assumes filing on the stated earlier filing date. Serve the owner notice of intent at least thirty days before actual filing; earlier actual filing requires an earlier notice. This planning target is not a universal statutory expiration and does not establish service or receipt.

lien_filing.name: File claim with circuit court clerk
lien_filing.description: Six calendar months, clamping missing month-day as the approved earlier target. Filing must wait thirty days after actual intent service.

lien_filing.name: File claim with prothonotary

lien_filing.name: File claim with prothonotary
lien_filing.description: Six calendar months after last contract-required delivery; missing month-day clamps. Act before weekend/known holiday, subject to PA-only closure review.

warnings: Draft implementation of the bound #327 form; exact implementation approval and canonical promotion are required before release.
The form preserves its original source-access and amendment-review limits. No new current-law review is claimed by this implementation.
Additional service, recording and amount conditions described below remain mandatory; this calculator is not a notice-sending or lien-filing service.
Intent candidate is raw six-month anniversary minus thirty days, as in the form. If filing earlier (including before a closed clerk day), move intent earlier too and wait the full thirty days.
Serve a claim copy within thirty days after actual filing. Calendar bounds do not authorize unverified 2027 holidays; source-currentness after July 1, 2026 remains pending.
A Saturday extension for a government or court filing depends on the governing office closure. The calculated baseline does not assume that fact; follow the earlier filing advice where shown.

preliminary_notice.name: 60-day supplier notice and 30-day intent
preliminary_notice.description: Serve two signed copies of supplier notice on owner/agent; separately serve intent at least thirty days before actual filing. Calculate the filing action target first, then subtract the full pre-filing notice interval; any notice-day adjustment moves earlier. The separate notice requirement could not be calculated because its calendar needs review. The displayed date covers only the independent first-delivery notice, not that separate requirement.

notice_duties.name: Sixty-day supplier notice
notice_duties.description: Serve the statutory supplier notice in two signed copies on the owner or authorized agent within sixty days after first furnishing. The later notice of intent is separate; this date does not establish service or receipt.

lien_filing.name: File claim with circuit court clerk
lien_filing.description: Six calendar months, clamping missing month-day as the approved earlier target. Filing must wait thirty days after actual intent service.

preliminary_notice.name: 75-day commercial notice and ten-day owner notice
preliminary_notice.description: Serve owner AND contractor first+75, including owner-hired suppliers under the safe-side decision. Separately give owner ten days before actual filing; calculate the ten-day target from the advised earlier filing date, keeping statutory filing expiration at last+120.

notice_duties.name: Commercial owner and contractor notice
notice_duties.description: Serve the owner and contractor within 75 days after first furnishing under the retained safe-side policy, including owner-hired suppliers. This first-delivery duty is separate from the ten-day pre-filing owner notice.

planned_notice_targets.name: Ten-day owner notice planning target
planned_notice_targets.description: This target assumes filing on the stated earlier filing date. Give the owner the full ten-day notice interval before actual filing; earlier actual filing requires an earlier notice. This planning target is not a universal statutory expiration and does not establish service or receipt.

lien_filing.name: File account and affidavit with circuit clerk
lien_filing.description: File account and affidavit with circuit clerk under the bound form; required service and filing conditions still apply. File by 2026-05-29 to avoid a closed filing day; the date calculated under this policy remains 2026-05-31.

preliminary_notice.name: Applicable furnishing and formal intent notices
preliminary_notice.description: File directory Notice of Furnishing within forty-five days of first delivery, including direct owner suppliers. Remote suppliers also give formal intent at least thirty days BEFORE the conservative claim filing date. File by 2026-02-13 to avoid a closed filing day; the date calculated under this policy remains 2026-02-15.

notice_duties.name: Directory Notice of Furnishing
notice_duties.description: File a Notice of Furnishing in the directory within forty-five days after first furnishing for the established searchable project with a filed and posted Notice of Commencement. The formal preclaim notice to the owner is separate.

planned_notice_targets.name: Thirty-day formal intent planning target
planned_notice_targets.description: This target assumes filing on the stated earlier filing date. Give the owner formal written notice of intent at least thirty days before actual filing; earlier actual filing requires an earlier notice. This planning target is not a universal statutory expiration and does not establish legally sufficient service.

lien_filing.name: File claim with prothonotary
lien_filing.description: Six calendar months after last contract-required delivery; missing month-day clamps. Act before weekend/known holiday, subject to PA-only closure review. File by 2026-07-02 to avoid a closed filing day; the date calculated under this policy remains 2026-07-03.
